text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 19 · 晨光冰晶宫殿.
Environment:  A luminous original ice palace hall, broad translucent frost-white columns with restrained snowflake geometry, graceful clear-ice stair curving upward, pale lavender and glacier-blue refractions on a smooth pearly floor. Bright diffuse morning light through crystalline windows, natural microbubbles and frost texture. Open central floor, no queen, statues, snowmen, animals or faces. Elegant rather than dark.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 3 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Edit this contact sheet. Remove panel D entirely because its layout is inconsistent. Retain original panels A, B and C exactly with their existing geometry, furniture, materials and light. Re-layout ONLY these three existing views as three panels side by side, labeled A, B, C. Preserve view content without cropping key architecture. Landscape overall. Do not invent objects or views. Empty environment, no people.
